thread:
Alex G: FYI - saw a cluster of 10-15s owner flips this morning tied to enrichment spikes during our webinar promo window. A few leads bounced between owners while SDRs were doing the live Q&A.
Marta L: Oof. timing sucks. We should avoid reassigning during known high-activity windows (webinar start +/- 30m). Could we add a calendar-aware quiet-mode for RR? :calendar:
Devon H: Yeah — feature flag gate + calendar windows. Quick idea: if event_window == true, RR should prefer 'sticky-first-owner' (TTL 4h) and suppress auto-reassigns unless manual override.
Priya N: Also, when webinar tag present on lead (utm_campaign=webinar), set lead.assign_priority = 'sticky' so it survives brief enrichment hiccups. That reduces churn for live engagement.
Sam R: For HubSpot snippet (pseudo):
```
IF utm_campaign CONTAINS 'webinar' OR event_window == true THEN set lead.property 'assign_mode'='webinar_sticky' AND owner_ttl = 4h
ELSE normal assign
```
Alex G: Ops playbook: 1) Enable webinar_quiet_mode 15m before event. 2) If reassignment spikes, pause RR and post examples to #sales-inbound. 3) After event, run a reconcile job to normalise owners.
Marta L: Add dashboards: webinar.assign_flips, webinar.sticky_promo_hits, and alert if flips > 3/min during event.
Devon H: Rollout: feature flag 'webinar_quiet_mode' default=false. Canary next webinar (Wed 13:00 PT) for 1 event. Success if owner_churn during event drops >= 60% and first-contact by SDR unaffected.
ops-bot: [automated] Feature flag created: webinar_quiet_mode (default=false). Monitoring: marketing.webinar.assign_flips, marketing.webinar.sticky_promo_hits.
Priya N: I'll prep the HubSpot workflow and a short SDR note template explaining provisional stickiness. Quick sync at 30m to finalize.
Alex G: Thanks team - goal: keep live leads stable during promo windows without changing baseline SLA. Follow-ups here after sync. :thumbsup:
